info.title: GetOrders
info.description: Use this API to get the list of items for a range of orders1..

get.description: Use this API to get the list of items for a range of orders1..

countTotal.description: Displayed in the Head section, this number tells the complete number of all orders for the current filter set in the database.

count.description: Displayed in the Head section, this number tells the complete number of all orders for the current filter set in the database(included offset and limit).

branch_number.description: (For Thailand only) The tax branch code for corporate customers, provided by the customer when placing the order.

tax_code.description: (For Thailand and Vietnam only) The customer's VAT tax code, provided by the customer when placing the order.

extra_attributes.description: Extra attributes which were passed to the Seller Center on getMarketPlaceOrders call.

shipping_fee.description: Total shipping fee for this order.

payment_method.description: The method of the payment. For details, see Payment method options.

statuses.description: An array of unique status of the items in the order. You can find all of the different status codes in the response example.

national_registration_number.description: National registration number. Required in some countries.

promised_shipping_times.description: Target shipping time for the soonest order item if they are available.

voucher_platform.description: The voucher that is issued by Lazada

voucher_seller.description: The voucher that is issued by the seller

created_at.description: Date and time when the order was placed.

price.description: Total amount for this order.Not the final transaction price of the order, excluding voucher and shipping_fee

address_billing.description: Node that contains additional nodes, which makes up the billing address: FirstName, LastName, Phone, Phone2, Address1, Address2, City, PostCode, and Country.

post_code.description: Post code; Note: This value will not be used in Lazada ID

shipping_fee_original.description: the original shipping fee which are supposed to be charged to the customer, before any type of shipping fee promotion

address_shipping.description: Node that contains additional nodes, which makes up the shipping address: FirstName, LastName, Phone, Phone2, Address1, Address2, City, PostCode, and Country.

post_code.description: Post code; Note: This value will not be used in Lazada ID

gift_option.description: 1 if item is a gift, and 0 if it is not.

voucher_code.description: The returned value is Voucher id

updated_at.description: Date and time of the last change to the order.

gift_message.description: Gift message as specified by the customer.

recipient_info.description: Information filled in by the buyer when placing an order

need_cancel_confirm.description: true: seller needs to respond to the cancellation request from buyer

is_cancel_pending.description: true: seller agrees the cancellation request, waiting for logistic system

default.description: See x-lazada-error-codes for documented error codes and guidance.

x-lazada-common-parameters.desc: Unique app ID issued by LAZADA Open Platform console when you apply for an app category

x-lazada-common-parameters.name: timestamp
x-lazada-common-parameters.desc: The time stamp of the request e.g. 1517820392000 (which translates to 5 February 2018 08:46:32) with less than 7200s difference from UTC time

x-lazada-common-parameters.desc: The HMAC hash algorithm you are using to calculate your signature

x-lazada-request-parameters.name: update_before
x-lazada-request-parameters.desc: Limits the returned orders to those updated before or on the specified date, given in ISO 8601 date format. Optional.

x-lazada-request-parameters.name: sort_direction
x-lazada-request-parameters.desc: Specify the sorting type. Possible values are ASC and DESC.

x-lazada-request-parameters.name: offset
x-lazada-request-parameters.desc: Number of orders to skip at the beginning of the list.

x-lazada-request-parameters.name: limit
x-lazada-request-parameters.desc: The maximum number of orders that can be returned. The supported maximum number is 100.

x-lazada-request-parameters.name: update_after
x-lazada-request-parameters.desc: Limits the returned orders to those updated after or on the specified date, given in ISO 8601 date format. Either UpdatedAfter or CreatedAfter is mandatory.

x-lazada-request-parameters.name: sort_by
x-lazada-request-parameters.desc: Allows to choose the sorting column. Possible values are created_at and updated_at.

x-lazada-request-parameters.name: created_before
x-lazada-request-parameters.desc: Limits the returned orders to those updated before or on the specified date, given in ISO 8601 date format. Optional.

x-lazada-request-parameters.name: created_after
x-lazada-request-parameters.desc: Limits the returned orders to those updated after or on the specified date, given in ISO 8601 date format. Either UpdatedAfter or CreatedAfter is mandatory.

x-lazada-request-parameters.name: status
x-lazada-request-parameters.desc: When set, limits the returned set of orders to loose orders, which return only entries which fit the status provided. Possible values are unpaid, pending, canceled, ready_to_ship, delivered, returned, shipped , failed, topack,toship,shipping and lost

client = LazopApiClient::Client.new(url, appkey, appSecret)
request = LazopApiClient::Request.new('/orders/get','GET')
request.add_api_parameter("update_before", "2018-02-10T16:00:00+08:00")
request.add_api_parameter("sort_direction", "DESC")
request.add_api_parameter("offset", "0")
request.add_api_parameter("limit", "10")
request.add_api_parameter("update_after", "2017-02-10T09:00:00+08:00")
request.add_api_parameter("sort_by", "updated_at")
request.add_api_parameter("created_before", "2018-02-10T16:00:00+08:00")
request.add_api_parameter("created_after", "2017-02-10T09:00:00+08:00")
request.add_api_parameter("status", "shipped")
response = client.execute(request, accessToken)
puts response.success?
puts response.body
